scope: Twenty source-linked examples for a visual catalog preview. Hero totals, filter counts and pagination are illustrative; previewWeights project these samples onto a 256-template overview, including 56 AI templates. They are not additional records. Repository stars and forks are actual GitHub snapshots.

provenance.notes: The original nine examples were checked against the public catalog and enriched from linked repository READMEs or manifests. The eleven added visual-preview examples use upstream catalog metadata only, with explicit unknown requirements and hosting defaults. Init commands follow the published Awesome azd gallery formatter and have not been executed. Record-level source notes distinguish these cases. Task labels, concise titles, topics, best-fit guidance and conceptual flows are editorial proposals. Missing metadata stays explicit. No deployment, availability, cost, security or usage ranking is claimed.
